scope: One descriptive baseline, not a candidate comparison or acceptance of a performance change.

metrics.worker_end_age: NativeProcessor ended minus source-clock captured_at; excludes result IPC and terminal commit.
metrics.durable_return_age: Parent monotonic timestamp immediately after ProcessWorkers.step returns, minus captured_at; journal ID required. Before explicit consumer acknowledgment.
metrics.post_worker_return_gap: Per-sample durable_return_age minus worker_end_age; not a difference of marginal percentiles.
metrics.drain: Timestamp after close returns; reported separately and excluded from in-window throughput/latency distributions.
